sources.title: Pearson correlation
sources.review_scope: Chunks 0 and 1 read. Formula, constant-input caveat, Fisher/bootstrap confidence intervals. No support for parlay independence claims.

sources.title: Bootstrap intervals
sources.review_scope: Chunks 0 and 1 read. Paired index resampling and percentile/BCa differences. Week-cluster resampling is this project's declared design choice, not a claim of guaranteed coverage.

sources.title: Confidence limits for the mean
sources.review_scope: Complete page read. A confidence interval is not the probability that this particular interval contains the mean.

sources.title: Bootstrap uncertainty
sources.review_scope: Complete page read; resampling with replacement; warns bootstrap is not appropriate for every statistic/distribution.

sources.title: Autocorrelation
sources.review_scope: Complete page read; motivates testing time dependence, not assuming independent outcomes.

sources.title: Multiple-testing corrections
sources.review_scope: Complete page read; Holm is the step-down Bonferroni procedure. All registered variants/looks count in this project's family.
